description:
Functional specifications/files: ServerManager expiry timers and supervisor recovery; fence expired runtimes, lazy fresh resolution, guard callbacks by server identity, stop surviving untracked children after manager restart.
Tests first: expiry boundaries, refreshed/replaced grant, stale callbacks, manager restart with surviving children.
Branches: future/past/no expiry, replaced/dead server, restart cleanup.
Mocking: injected deterministic clock/timers where existing lifecycle seam permits; real supervised children.
Docs: Agent expiry/restart guarantees.
Action reuse: extend existing timer, stop/drain and runtime-supervisor mechanisms; no reconciliation service or heartbeat.
title: [zaq-jrg] Harden credential expiry and Agent manager restart
